integrity: Analytic proof and supplementary exact arithmetic; independently validated mathematical correctness has not been established.
scientific_limitations: Exact equality in radial Hilbert Fock spaces of entire functions with nonzero absolutely continuous weight and finite moments; no point-mass weights, nonradial weights, or non-Hilbert p cases. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a possible originality risk.
title: Complete equality rigidity for arbitrary radial weighted Fock Korenblum inequalities
